message.content:
The members are now copy-constructed directly from the source in the initializer list instead of being default-constructed and then copy-assigned, which performs a single sized allocation-and-copy per vector and skips the extra self-assignment, capacity, and element-destruction checks of `operator=`.

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values),
      stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}
```
